Select approved drugs with mechanism action_type 'BLOCKER'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno, and to target_dictionary on drug_mechanism.tid. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter where max_phase equals 4 and action_type equals 'BLOCKER'. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id (as target_dictionary.chembl_id), and target_name (as target_dictionary.pref_name). Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
